subject.title: 🐛 Feishu channel fails with tenant_access_token error when HTTP proxy is configured

question: Should Feishu SDK HTTP/token and WS bootstrap traffic follow OpenClaw ambient/managed proxy routing through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/86386, bypass proxy routing by default, or wait for an explicit per-channel proxy policy?
rationale: The bug blocks real Feishu users, but the fix decides whether credentialed Feishu/Lark traffic follows or bypasses operator-controlled proxy egress.

options.title: Approve Ambient/Managed Proxy Routing
options.body: Land the linked PR after refresh if maintainers want Feishu SDK HTTP to follow OpenClaw's shared ambient and managed proxy helper contract.

options.title: Require Per-Channel Policy First
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged until Feishu has an explicit direct versus proxy policy covering SDK HTTP, WebSocket, guarded-fetch calls, docs, and tests.

options.title: Document Workaround Only
options.body: Reject runtime proxy routing changes for now and rely on NO_PROXY/operator environment guidance, accepting that affected users must repair routing manually.

recommendation.title: Approve Ambient/Managed Proxy Routing
recommendation.body: Land the linked PR after refresh if maintainers want Feishu SDK HTTP to follow OpenClaw's shared ambient and managed proxy helper contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about shared proxy helper behavior and managed egress boundaries, where steipete has the clearest recent history.
